process GAPPA_EDITMERGE {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_low'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/4a/4a30e4444b69c99470cae4a631a9e293ed76d475a6a44812a1f38ad2b9ece7af/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/gappa:0.9.0--2f0efa59bcb34481'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(jplace)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("*.merge.jplace*"), emit: jplace
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('gappa'), eval("gappa --version 2>&1 | sed 's/v//'"), emit: versions_gappa, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    gappa \\
        edit \\
        merge \\
        ${args} \\
        --threads ${task.cpus} \\
        --file-prefix ${prefix}. \\
        --jplace-path ${jplace}
    """

    stub:
    def prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    """
    touch ${prefix}.merge.jplace
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/gappa/editmerge"
description: "Merges the pqueries of several jplace files, placed on a common reference\
  \ tree, into a single jplace file"
keywords:
- "merge"
- "jplace"
- "phylogenetic placement"
tools:
- gappa:
    description: "Genesis Applications for Phylogenetic Placement Analysis"
    homepage: "https://github.com/lczech/gappa"
    documentation: "https://github.com/lczech/gappa/wiki"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/lczech/gappa"
    doi: "10.1093/bioinformatics/btaa070"
    licence:
    - "GPL v3"
    identifier: "biotools:GAPPA"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
  - jplace:
      type: "file"
      description: "Two or more jplace files output from phylogenetic placement, e.g.\
        \ EPA-NG,\ngzipped or not. All of them must reference the same tree; gappa\
        \ aborts with\n\"Input jplace files have differing reference trees.\" if they\
        \ do not.\n"
      pattern: "*.{jplace,jplace.gz}"
      ontologies: []
output:
  jplace:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. [ id:'test' ]\n"
    - '*.merge.jplace*':
        type: "file"
        description: "Single jplace file holding the pqueries of every input file.\
          \ Gzipped when\n`--compress` is passed via `task.ext.args`.\n"
        pattern: "*.merge.jplace{,.gz}"
        ontologies: []
  versions_gappa:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - gappa:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - gappa --version 2>&1 | sed 's/v//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - gappa:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - gappa --version 2>&1 | sed 's/v//':
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
